lines.rom: yako janma bhayo ko karana tabahim mohi karayo yaha dharana
akhila bhuvana maham kaham koi nahim saba kachu ahai nihita mo mahim
yaha niscaya kari garaba barhayo nija kaham brahma mani sukhapaye
gagana gira taba bhai gambhira brahma vacana sunahu dhari dhira
sakala srsti kara svami joi brahma anadi alakha hai soi
nija iccha una saba niramaye brahma visnu mahesa banaye
srsti lagi pragate trayadeva saba jaga inaki karihai seva
mahapadma jo tumharo asana ta pai ahai visnu ko sasana
visnu nabhitem pragatyo ai tuma kaham satya dinha samujhai
bhaimtahu jai visnu hitamani yaha kahi banda bhai nabhavani
tahi sravana kahi acaraja mana puni caturanana kinha payana
kamala nala dhari nice ava taham visnu ke darsana pava
sayana karata dekhe surabhupa syamavarna tanu parama anupa
sohata caturbhuja atisundara kritamukata rajata mastaka para
gala baijanti mala birajai koti surya ki sobha lajai
samkha cakra aru gada manohara padma sahita ayudha saba sundara
payam palotati rama nirantara sesa naga sayya ati manahara
divyarupa lakhi kinha pranamu harsita bhe sripati sukha dhamu
bahu vidhi vinaya kinha caturanana taba laksmi pati kaheu mudita mana
brahma duri karahu abhimana brahmarupa hama dou samana
tije sri sivasankara ahim brahmarupa saba tribhuvana mamhim
